title: Ranking signals the checker misses: scene coherence (CLAP), continuity, processing cost
description: 2026-09-27: the user judged the Emerge swap (Alex Beroza, same artist as Ave) 'much better' than three others, good enough to send to their business partner, while the checker scored all four within ~4 points (Emerge 3rd). What set Emerge apart, measured: CLAP similarity to the scene's own loop 0.82 (highest in the library; the others 0.57-0.73); 16 long loop events vs 33-38 retriggered phrase fragments; stretch 1.00 (Absolutely Clear needed 1.34). Hypotheses, not rules (n=1): add terms (1) scene coherence = CLAP cosine of the candidate clip to the stack's clips/stems, (2) continuity = retriggers per bar and loop-seam quality, (3) processing cost = |log stretch| and transposition size, to the explorer and optimizer ranking with modest weights; log them for every rated candidate; backtest on earlier verdicts in renders/log.jsonl (cycle 2, the pad test); let Listen-page verdicts calibrate (Bradley-Terry once enough pairs).
